text:
Markus Klein: Heads up — I’ve now had 3 prospects in the last week ask “can you just send me the link to the AWS Marketplace FAQ so I can forward to procurement?” We keep answering ad hoc.

Do we have a customer-facing FAQ link we can share today (even if it’s a draft)?

Suggested wording for the email (feel free to edit):
“Yep — you can purchase Redwood Inference via AWS Marketplace (supports PO/committed spend via your AWS bill). This FAQ covers how the purchase maps to your Redwood org, activation steps, and common troubleshooting. If your procurement team needs a private offer or custom terms, we can coordinate via AWS Marketplace.”

If someone can drop the canonical link, I’ll update our SE snippets.

Jordan Blake: +1, seeing same in enterprise cycles. Also: please include a single line on support path (what to do if entitlement doesn’t show up right away). That’s the #1 procurement-stage anxiety.

Soojin Lee: We have a draft customer FAQ in Drive but agree we need a canonical docs link. @Elliot Price can we point folks to the new docs page yet, even if it’s “preview”?

Elliot Price: We can share the docs link now. It’s live on prod but we’re still polishing copy.
Customer-facing AWS Marketplace FAQ + onboarding: https://docs.redwoodinference.com/guides/cloud-marketplace/aws

FAQ section anchor (entitlements, billing, upgrades, troubleshooting): https://docs.redwoodinference.com/guides/cloud-marketplace/aws#faq

If you want a short link for forwarding, I can add a redirect under /marketplace/aws later today.

Markus Klein: Amazing, thank you. Is the language on “PO/committed spend” okay? Don’t want to overpromise.

Soojin Lee: “PO/committed spend” is generally true but I’d soften it.
Maybe:
“You can purchase via AWS Marketplace and have usage billed through your AWS account. This is often used for consolidated cloud spend and procurement workflows.”

Also please avoid “custom terms” unless we mean private offer — partner team wants consistent terminology.

Elliot Price: Agree. Also, on the troubleshooting/support line: we should keep it factual and point to support contact + what info to include.
The page currently says:
- “Entitlements typically activate within a few minutes. If it’s been >30 minutes, contact support@redwoodinference.com with your AWS account ID and the Marketplace subscription ID.”

Jasmine Liu: From CS side: that’s perfect. Please add “and your Redwood org slug” if they have it.
We’ve had a couple cases where folks have multiple orgs and it slows us down.

Dev Patel: +1. And please don’t tell customers to “retry purchase” — it creates duplicates. We can add one line: “Do not re-subscribe; contact support and we’ll help.”

Soojin Lee: I’ll send a small PR request to adjust those two lines (org slug + don’t re-subscribe). @Markus Klein for the email snippet, here’s a cleaned up version you can paste:

“Yep — Redwood Inference is available via AWS Marketplace. This guide covers purchase + activation steps, how Marketplace entitlements map to your Redwood org, billing basics, and common troubleshooting:
https://docs.redwoodinference.com/guides/cloud-marketplace/aws#faq

If your procurement team needs a Private Offer, we can coordinate through AWS Marketplace.”

Markus Klein: Perfect. I’ll use that and update the SE talk track doc. :thumbsup:

Jordan Blake: Can we also add a line for buyers who want Dedicated/Private (VPC) — like “Marketplace purchase supports Hosted API today; Dedicated/Private available via private offer / contact sales”? Not sure what we’re promising in docs.

Soojin Lee: Good catch. We should mirror whatever Packaging decided. I *think* the intent is Dedicated + Private SKUs exist, but not sure if they’re live for AWS yet.
@Elliot Price can you confirm what the docs currently claim?

Elliot Price: Current doc is careful: it says “Available plans vary by Marketplace listing/region. For Dedicated capacity or Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments, contact Sales or request a Private Offer.”
So it doesn’t promise a specific SKU is purchasable without talking to us.

Jordan Blake: That works. Thanks.

Markus Klein: Closing the loop: prospect is asking for “something official” to forward. The docs link is exactly what we need. Appreciate it.

Elliot Price: I’ll add the /marketplace/aws redirect and post here when it’s done.

Soojin Lee: :white_check_mark: I’ll align wording with the listing copy too so it’s consistent.

Elliot Price: Redirect is live: https://docs.redwoodinference.com/marketplace/aws (forwards to the guide).

Markus Klein: Legend. Using this going forward.
